APP_PACKAGE.prompt: Application base package, e.g. com.acme.myddd (no default: it cannot be guessed from a hyphenated artifactId)

ARCHETYPE_SOURCE.prompt: local (derive from the bundled scaffold) or published

post_create.cmd: APP_GROUP_ID='{{APP_GROUP_ID}}' APP_ARTIFACT_ID='{{APP_ARTIFACT_ID}}' APP_VERSION='{{APP_VERSION}}' APP_PACKAGE='{{APP_PACKAGE}}' ARCHETYPE_SOURCE='{{ARCHETYPE_SOURCE}}' ARCHETYPE_VERSION='{{ARCHETYPE_VERSION}}' ARCHETYPE_REPOSITORY='{{ARCHETYPE_REPOSITORY}}' sh scripts/new-app.sh && rm -f scripts/new-app.sh && { rmdir scripts 2>/dev/null || :; }
